lessons.title: Reading Files
lessons.content: Kotlin's stdlib adds readText(), readLines(), forEachLine() extensions on File. Real scenario: reading a bundled fallback JSON file from assets before any network sync.

codeSnippets.code:
val content = File(path).readText()
File(path).forEachLine { line -> processLine(line) }

lessons.title: Writing Files
lessons.content: writeText() and appendText() write/append to a File in one call without manual stream management. Real scenario: writing a local debug log or exporting user data in a CLI tool.

lessons.title: BufferedReader
lessons.content: Wraps a Reader with an internal buffer, reducing I/O operations for line-by-line reading. Real scenario: processing a large CSV file line by line without loading it all into memory.

lessons.title: BufferedWriter
lessons.content: Buffers write operations, reducing disk writes for many small sequential writes. Real scenario: writing many small log entries without a disk write per line.

lessons.title: Serialization Concepts
lessons.content: Converts an in-memory object to a storable format and back. Real scenario: your Lesson data class serialized to/from JSON when synced and cached locally.

codeSnippets.code:
@Serializable
data class Lesson(val id: String, val title: String, val content: String)

lessons.title: JSON Parsing Basics
lessons.content: Converting a raw JSON string into structured Kotlin objects. Real scenario: parsing your app's manifest.json response into a ManifestDto.

lessons.title: kotlinx.serialization Deep Dive
lessons.content: Kotlin's official multiplatform serialization library, generating code at compile time via a plugin instead of runtime reflection. Real scenario: powers your app's GitHubContentApi DTOs.
